answer: Each TEE-enabled unit performs a 4GB memory-hard challenge to reach the network zenith. A verifier checks the signed attestation within a virtual garden, ensuring the violet silicon key is unique. Honest nodes pay 1 watt of power per identity, whereas 1,000 fakes demand 1,000 watts of verified hardware output. Failure to provide a violet signature at the zenith triggers a block, clearing the garden.
